name: Roll a cylinder
description: Roll a lying constant-radius cylinder (rolling pin, can on its side) along its support by pressing on its top; the object must rotate, not slide. A bottle with a neck rolls in an arc around the neck and is not a valid noun.

precheck.name: hand_empty
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: base_near
precheck.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: lying
precheck.meaning: Object on its side: longest axis within 60 deg of horizontal and vertical extent <= 60 % of its length.
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: object_rolled
verifier.meaning: Object rotated at least 45 deg about a horizontal axis while staying on its side.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving
